meanings.en: mentioned earlier in the same text or document
meanings.exampleEn: Please refer to the above-mentioned terms before signing the contract.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözleşmeyi imzalamadan önce lütfen yukarıda bahsedilen şartlara başvurun.

meanings.en: to get used to a new climate, environment, or situation
meanings.exampleEn: It took the climbers a week to acclimate to the high altitude.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağcıların yüksek irtifaya alışması bir hafta sürdü.

meanings.en: as stated or reported by a person or source
meanings.exampleEn: According to the weather forecast, it will rain tomorrow.
meanings.exampleTr: Hava tahminine göre yarın yağmur yağacak.

meanings.en: angry and bitter feelings or words
meanings.exampleEn: The negotiations ended in acrimony, with neither side willing to compromise.
meanings.exampleTr: Müzakereler, hiçbir tarafın uzlaşmaya yanaşmamasıyla husumet içinde sona erdi.

meanings.en: involving opposition or conflict between two sides
meanings.exampleEn: The two companies had an adversarial relationship for years.
meanings.exampleTr: İki şirketin yıllarca çekişmeli bir ilişkisi vardı.

meanings.en: floating on water rather than sinking
meanings.exampleEn: They struggled to keep the small boat afloat during the storm.
meanings.exampleTr: Fırtına sırasında küçük tekneyi su üstünde tutmaya çalıştılar.

meanings.en: having enough money to stay out of debt or survive financially
meanings.exampleEn: The company barely stayed afloat during the recession.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, durgunluk döneminde güçbela ayakta kaldı.

meanings.en: mentioned or named before, especially in a legal document
meanings.exampleEn: The aforesaid party shall be responsible for all damages.
meanings.exampleTr: Yukarıda adı geçen taraf, tüm zararlardan sorumlu olacaktır.

meanings.en: in opposition to someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: Many people protested against the new law.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok insan yeni yasaya karşı protesto düzenledi.

meanings.en: touching or leaning on something for support
meanings.exampleEn: He leaned his bike against the wall.
meanings.exampleTr: Bisikletini duvara yasladı.

meanings.en: the ages between and including two limits
meanings.exampleEn: This toy is suitable for children in the age range of three to six.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu oyuncak üç ila altı yaş aralığındaki çocuklar için uygundur.

meanings.en: including everything, especially all costs or services
meanings.exampleEn: We booked an all-inclusive holiday package to Turkey.
meanings.exampleTr: Türkiye'ye her şey dahil bir tatil paketi ayırttık.

meanings.en: permitted by rules or law
meanings.exampleEn: The maximum allowable weight for the luggage is 23 kilograms.
meanings.exampleTr: Bagaj için izin verilebilir azami ağırlık 23 kilogramdır.

meanings.en: next to or by the side of something or someone
meanings.exampleEn: She worked alongside her colleagues to finish the project.
meanings.exampleTr: Projeyi bitirmek için meslektaşlarıyla birlikte çalıştı.

meanings.en: surrounded by or in the middle of a group
meanings.exampleEn: She felt safe among her friends.
meanings.exampleTr: Arkadaşlarının arasında kendini güvende hissetti.

meanings.en: surrounded by or in the middle of a group (mainly British)
meanings.exampleEn: The decision caused disagreement amongst the members.
meanings.exampleTr: Karar, üyeler arasında anlaşmazlığa neden oldu.

meanings.en: the indefinite article used before words beginning with a vowel sound
meanings.exampleEn: She ate an apple for breakfast.
meanings.exampleTr: Kahvaltıda bir elma yedi.

meanings.en: in a way that involves comparison based on similarity
meanings.exampleEn: He explained the complex idea analogically, comparing it to a flowing river.
meanings.exampleTr: Karmaşık fikri, onu akan bir nehre benzeterek analojik olarak açıkladı.

meanings.en: used to join words or parts of sentences
meanings.exampleEn: I bought bread and milk from the store.
meanings.exampleTr: Mağazadan ekmek ve süt aldım.

meanings.en: the scientific study of animals and their life processes
meanings.exampleEn: Her research focuses on animal biology, especially the behavior of mammals.
meanings.exampleTr: Araştırması hayvan biyolojisine, özellikle memelilerin davranışına odaklanıyor.

meanings.en: an informal term for a veterinarian
meanings.exampleEn: We took our sick cat to the animal doctor.
meanings.exampleTr: Hasta kedimizi veterinere götürdük.

meanings.en: all the animals living in a particular area or environment
meanings.exampleEn: The rainforest is rich in plant and animal life.
meanings.exampleTr: Yağmur ormanı bitki ve hayvan yaşamı açısından zengindir.

meanings.en: one more or a different one of the same kind
meanings.exampleEn: Would you like another cup of coffee?
meanings.exampleTr: Bir fincan kahve daha ister misin?

meanings.en: opposed to a particular policy, action, or person
meanings.exampleEn: She is strongly anti any form of censorship.
meanings.exampleTr: Her türlü sansüre kesinlikle karşı.

meanings.en: some amount or number, used in questions and negatives
meanings.exampleEn: Is there any milk left in the fridge?
meanings.exampleTr: Buzdolabında hiç süt kaldı mı?

meanings.en: any person, no matter which
meanings.exampleEn: Is there anybody here who can speak French?
meanings.exampleTr: Burada Fransızca konuşabilen biri var mı?

meanings.en: any person at all
meanings.exampleEn: Anyone can learn to cook with a little practice.
meanings.exampleTr: Biraz pratikle herkes yemek yapmayı öğrenebilir.

meanings.en: a thing of any kind
meanings.exampleEn: I don't want anything to eat right now.
meanings.exampleTr: Şu anda yemek için hiçbir şey istemiyorum.

meanings.en: in a way that shows no interest, emotion, or concern
meanings.exampleEn: The students stared apathetically at the teacher, bored by the lecture.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrenciler dersten sıkılmış halde öğretmene ilgisizce baktılar.

meanings.en: to add something to the end of a piece of writing or document
meanings.exampleEn: Please append your signature to the bottom of the form.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen imzanızı formun altına ekleyin.

meanings.en: very old-fashioned or belonging to an earlier period
meanings.exampleEn: The document was written in archaic language that few people could understand.
meanings.exampleTr: Belge, çok az kişinin anlayabileceği eski bir dille yazılmıştı.

meanings.en: used to say that something happens during the time when something else happens, or to give a reason
meanings.exampleEn: As it was getting late, we decided to go home.
meanings.exampleTr: Vakit geç olduğu için eve gitmeye karar verdik.

meanings.en: used to describe the role or function of someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: She works as a nurse in the local hospital.
meanings.exampleTr: Yerel hastanede hemşire olarak çalışıyor.

meanings.en: except for; in addition to
meanings.exampleEn: Aside from a few minor errors, the report was excellent.
meanings.exampleTr: Birkaç küçük hata dışında rapor mükemmeldi.

meanings.en: a person who physically attacks someone
meanings.exampleEn: The victim was unable to identify the assaulter in the dark.
meanings.exampleTr: Mağdur, karanlıkta saldırganı teşhis edemedi.

meanings.en: the process of becoming part of a group or absorbing information
meanings.exampleEn: The assimilation of immigrants into society can take several generations.
meanings.exampleTr: Göçmenlerin topluma asimilasyonu birkaç nesil sürebilir.

meanings.en: used to show a particular place, position, or time
meanings.exampleEn: We will meet at the station at six o'clock.
meanings.exampleTr: Saat altıda istasyonda buluşacağız.

meanings.tr: spor-günlük giyim (hem spor hem gündelik kullanılan)
meanings.en: casual, comfortable clothing designed to be worn for exercise and everyday activities
meanings.exampleEn: Athleisure has become a huge trend in the fashion industry.
meanings.exampleTr: Spor-günlük giyim, moda endüstrisinde büyük bir trend haline geldi.

meanings.en: the quality of being ordinary or not special
meanings.exampleEn: There was a comforting averageness about the small town.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük kasabada rahatlatıcı bir sıradanlık vardı.

meanings.en: not according to plan; wrong or twisted to one side
meanings.exampleEn: Their carefully made plans went awry at the last minute.
meanings.exampleTr: Özenle yaptıkları planlar son dakikada ters gitti.

meanings.en: the state of being empty, infertile, or unproductive
meanings.exampleEn: The barrenness of the desert stretched as far as the eye could see.
meanings.exampleTr: Çölün çoraklığı gözün görebildiği kadar uzanıyordu.

meanings.tr: sorumlu olmak, hesap vermekle yükümlü olmak
meanings.en: to be responsible for something and required to explain your actions
meanings.exampleEn: Managers must be accountable for the decisions they make.
meanings.exampleTr: Yöneticiler aldıkları kararlardan sorumlu olmalıdır.

meanings.en: to be similar to each other
meanings.exampleEn: The two sisters are very alike in appearance.
meanings.exampleTr: İki kız kardeş görünüş olarak birbirine çok benziyor.

meanings.en: to feel or show gratitude and thankfulness
meanings.exampleEn: We would be appreciative of any help you could offer.
meanings.exampleTr: Sunabileceğiniz her türlü yardım için minnettar oluruz.

meanings.tr: uzakta olmak, yokta olmak, ayrılmış olmak
meanings.en: to be absent or not present at a place
meanings.exampleEn: She will be away on business next week.
meanings.exampleTr: Gelecek hafta iş için şehir dışında olacak.

meanings.en: to not give enough attention or care to what you are doing
meanings.exampleEn: Don't be careless with your money when you travel.
meanings.exampleTr: Seyahat ederken paranı harcarken dikkatsiz olma.

meanings.en: to be completely sure about something
meanings.exampleEn: I am certain that I locked the door before leaving.
meanings.exampleTr: Çıkmadan önce kapıyı kilitlediğimden eminim.

meanings.en: to not be the same as someone or something else
meanings.exampleEn: My opinion may be different from yours.
meanings.exampleTr: Benim görüşüm seninkinden farklı olabilir.
